warnings: Axes: x = 1-2-3-4 at 4.00 + 3.00 + 4.00 (11.00); y = A-B-C at 4.00 + 1.50 (5.50). Origin A1 (row A is the top row of every plan). The same main chains print on S-01 (both views), S-02, A-03 (floor and roof plan), A-06 and A-07 and all agree. Vector CAD PDF with no text layer; every figure was read off the rendered page.

Section 4 rule 4: structural ticks 2' (5.50, S-01/A-03/T2), A''' (2.00, S-01/S-02/A-03), C' (6.75 = C + 1.25, S-01 footing plan) and C'' (6.85 = C + 1.35, S-01 structure plan, A-03, A-07); roof ticks 1'/4' (1.00 eave each side) and A'/B' (1.00 eave each side, A-03 roof plan); truss panel ticks A''/A'''' (T1 1.00 x 4) and 1''/1'''/3'/3'' (T2 1.33 x 3 in each 4.00 bay).

C' (6.75) and C'' (6.85) are 0.10 apart and kept as two lines: the footing plan prints 1.25 beyond C to the stair-foot footing F1 (matching the ST-1 run 1.25 on S-03), the structure plan, A-03 and A-07 print 1.35 to the outer end of the stair. Different points, not one edge printed twice.

T2 panel ticks are printed 1.33 three times inside a 4.00 bay (1.33 x 3 = 3.99). The positions are taken as thirds of the printed 4.00 (1.333 / 2.667 from grid 1; 8.333 / 9.667 from grid 3) so the chain closes on the named grids; each printed segment is within 0.004 m of it.
Rafter positions (จันทัน @1.00 m) are a printed spacing, not a dimension row, so they made no dummy lines; the rafters are recorded per bay on the roof-framing plan file.
Not dimension-swept: A-04, A-05 (elevations), A-08, A-09, E-01, SN-01, SN-02 — op04 scope; their numbers are not in dimension_chains[] or unassigned_dimensions[].

dummy_grid_rule_check.negative_pos_m: x: 1' = -1.00 (roof eave left of grid 1). y: A' = -1.00 (roof eave above row A).
